name: Generali
description: Se connecte à l'espace client Generali (generali.fr) pour récupérer les décomptes de remboursement santé.

status.notes: Site migrated off the old Drupal espace-client. generali.fr/espace-client/* now 302-redirects to the monespace.generali.fr Angular SPA (empty app-root, no server-rendered login form), so the old virtual-keypad Drupal POST and the Drupal AJAX .../mes-remboursements/more endpoint no longer exist. Login is now OIDC authorization-code + PKCE against an Ilex Sign&go IdP (authorize/token at www.ssoic.generali.fr/IdPOAuth2/.../SSOIC_OIDC_EMPREINTE, client_id 8B8C7A9CFD24EF04 for the GLI distributor, redirect_uri https://www.monespace.generali.fr/connexion), and the IdP's adaptive schema is 'Multifactor authentication with OTP SMS' - an SMS code is required on every fresh login. Reimbursements now come from JSON APIs behind the SPA/Apigee, not HTML. Fixing this is a full rewrite to the OIDC flow (fyde.input.ask for the SMS OTP) that needs a real account + a fresh HAR of the new login and a reimbursement fetch to build and verify; it can't be done from the old script's assumptions or confirmed without credentials.
